sources.title: Visas para extranjeros: country classification
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Guatemala
sources.officialityEvidence: Guatemala’s Foreign Ministry publishes the A/B/C nationality schedule; the current record places Andorra in both A and B.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Categoría “A” Exento; Categoría “B” Visa consular; Categoría “C” Visa consultada.

sources.title: Clasificación de países
sources.officialityEvidence: Guatemala’s migration authority defines the visitor consequence of Category A while the MINEX schedule leaves assigned cells ambiguous or unnamed.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Los países que se encuentran en la categoría A, no necesitan visa para ingresar al territorio guatemalteco.

sources.title: Nicaragua eAIP GEN 1.3: passenger entry, transit and exit
sources.publisher: Instituto Nicaragüense de Aeronáutica Civil / COCESNA eAIP
sources.officialityEvidence: Nicaragua’s official state eAIP supplies its A/B/C ordinary-passport entry schedule; the five assigned passports are not given a direct usable result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: debe de solicitar ante el consulado un aval de la Direccion General de Migración y Extranjería

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa application eligibility form
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MFA ordinary-document application uses a nationality selector and calls its same-origin eligibility gate; Taiwan and Kosovo are absent from the selector.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa ordinary-passport Tourist result
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The current same-origin result returns the ordinary Tourist product only after a positive gate; Afghanistan’s exact gate did not expose Tourist.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourist visa («TS») is issued to an applicant, intending to visit Kyrgyz Republic with purpose of tourism, for a period up to 30 days.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa information and application FAQ
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MFA FAQ establishes pre-entry electronic confirmation where eligibility has been positively established, but not for all nationality records.
sources.supportingExcerpt: After receiving your e-Visa confirmation through this portal, you can enter the Kyrgyz Republic during e-Visa validity period.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MFA guidance continues to name Cuba and North Korea in its former-USSR all-passport waiver group, conflicting with the current session-bound ordinary-passport portal outcome.

unresolved.reason: The current MINEX schedule places Andorra in both Category A and Category B. Official category guidance cannot reconcile the contradictory ordinary-passport outcomes.
MINEX United Kingdom wording concerns certain British passports connected to Hong Kong, not an HKSAR ordinary passport. No direct Guatemala or Hong Kong authority maps it.
No current Guatemalan authority directly classifies an ordinary Macao SAR passport. China wording, a conditional visa-holder route and omission do not establish a baseline.
Kosovo is not expressly named in Guatemala’s current ordinary-passport categories. Generic process material does not resolve document recognition or issuance.
Guatemala’s schedule’s Sudan row does not directly classify South Sudan. No separate current ordinary-passport route was recovered.
Nicaragua’s current Category A schedule names Switzerland but leaves the ordinary-passport cell blank. No current Swiss or Nicaraguan authority fills that cell.
Macao is not directly mapped in Nicaragua’s current A/B/C ordinary-passport schedule, and Macao’s authority does not directly name Nicaragua.
South Africa is not directly mapped in Nicaragua’s current ordinary-passport schedule. No direct authority establishes a nationwide visitor route.
Kosovo is not directly mapped in Nicaragua’s schedule and no direct authority establishes recognition or issuance timing.
South Sudan is not directly mapped in Nicaragua’s schedule and no direct authority establishes issuance timing.
Taiwan is absent from the current MFA application selector. China or portal omission cannot establish a Taiwan ordinary-passport route.
Kosovo is absent from the current MFA application selector. Recognition or portal omission cannot establish a Kosovo ordinary-passport route.

Current MFA waiver guidance names Cuba visa-free, but the session-bound ordinary-passport endpoint says Visa free regime: no and offers Tourist. No controlling treaty-status source resolves the conflict.

Current MFA waiver guidance names North Korea visa-free, but the session-bound ordinary-passport endpoint says Visa free regime: no and offers Tourist. No controlling treaty-status source resolves the conflict.
Afghanistan’s exact current controlling gate does not expose Tourist (TS). Generic Tourist product text cannot supply a positive ordinary Afghan-passport eligibility result.
